quarterly_data.signal: HPE's fiscal Q3 2026 earnings release (quarter ended July 31, 2026) raised the fiscal 2026 revenue growth outlook to 34% to 37% and the Networking segment revenue growth expectation to 73% to 74%. Cloud & AI operating profit margin was 17.0% versus 7.0% a year earlier, and Networking operating profit margin was 22.0% versus 22.1%.
